text:
I don't have access to your email address or order information until I can authenticate your identity first. This is a security requirement to protect your account.

Since you don't remember your email address, I can help you look up your account using your name and zip code instead. Could you please provide:

1. Your first name
2. Your last name  
3. Your zip code

Once I verify your identity, I'll be able to access your order details and show you how much you paid.
zh:
在验证你的身份之前，我无法访问你的邮箱地址或订单信息。这是为了保护你的账户而采取的安全措施。

因为你记不住邮箱地址，我可以帮你用你的名字和邮编查找账户。你能提供以下信息吗？

1. 你的名
2. 你的姓 
3. 你的邮编

一旦我验证了你的身份，我就能访问你的订单详情，并告诉你付了多少钱。
